title: Design: Internal work order lines show cost and hours with no prices
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a customer flagged as Internal customer, with one asset, and its default internal category left at General Internal.
  • Have a new internal work order for that customer and asset, with one labor line (1.0 h) and one stock part with a cost (for example $95.00), the line In Progress, made for this test.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow1-08-03-work-order-in-progress.png, iwo-happy-14-14-in-progress-cost-and-hours-no-prices.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The lines table shows quantity, cost and hours, with no Rate, Margin or Total column.
  • There is no total, tax, fee or discount block; in its place one "Shop supplies" field shows a dollar amount.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close), story SV-11767 (Story 10, Shop supplies on internal and no-charge work orders)

  • S2-R4: “Lines on an internal or no-charge work order show quantity, cost (parts) and hours (labor) and no sell prices: the Rate, Margin and Total columns of the lines table (a part's sell price sits in Rate) and the Sell price, Rate and Margin fields of the line and part dialogs are hidden and not required; there is no work order total, tax, fee or discount block; the shop supplies block is the flat amount of Story 10.”
  • S10-R1: “An internal or no-charge work order carries one field "Shop supplies" (a dollar amount) in the block where a billable work order shows its totals.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: pages "Flow 1 · Create and close" / "Happy flow v6", boards "03 Work order · in progress" (Flow 1 · Create and close), "14 In progress: cost and hours, no prices" (Happy flow v6).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • iwo-flow1-08-03-work-order-in-progress.png
  • iwo-happy-14-14-in-progress-cost-and-hours-no-prices.png

The design's own words:

  • “Shop supplies”
  • “$25.00”

Difference: the design keeps Rate and Total on the lines and a Value column in Financial Info: register IWO-D17, settled by S2-R4.
